📄 What is an STL File?
STL = Standard Tessellation Language

Describes your 3D model as a mesh of triangles
Every curve → collection of tiny flat triangles

Finer mesh = smoother curves (bigger file)
For flat magnet frames: files are small, under 5MB

The universal format every 3D printer slicer understands
';

actions.text: TinkerCAD Export: Click Export → Select .STL → Downloads immediately
TinkerCAD always exports clean, watertight meshes — no errors!

actions.script:
document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #0A0A0F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
⚙️ Export from Fusion 360
1. Right-click body in Browser → Save as Mesh
2. Format: STL (Binary) — much smaller than ASCII
3. Refinement: Fine for production, Medium for prototypes
4. Click OK and save

Fusion 360 gives more control over mesh quality than TinkerCAD
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #0A0A0F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
⚠️ Common STL Problems
Non-Manifold Edges
Holes in mesh from overlapping bodies or bad Booleans.
Fix: Repair in Meshmixer (free)
Inverted Normals
Faces point inward — slicer may see hollow areas.
Fix: Most slicers auto-fix, but export clean is best
Zero-Thickness Walls
Walls thinner than one nozzle width cannot print.
Fix: Check minimum wall in slicer preview
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #0A0A0F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
✅ Test Slicing Checklist
Open STL in Cura or PrusaSlicer → Slice → Layer Preview

☐ Magnet holes → empty cylinders in correct layers
☐ Photo pocket → rectangular void visible
☐ Retention lip → visible step in cross-section
☐ Walls → continuous, no gaps
☐ Infill → fills all enclosed spaces
☐ Overall dimensions match your design
';

document.body.style.cssText = 'margin:0; background: #0A0A0F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100vh; font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, sans-serif;'; document.body.innerHTML = '
📁 File Management for Production
📂 Organize by frame style → photo size subfolders
📝 Append version numbers: RetroTV_InstaxMini_v2.stl
💾 Keep both source CAD + exported STL
☁️ Back up everything to cloud storage

Each frame design represents hours of work — treat your STL library as a business asset!
';
